notes.title: Difficulty Reduction Patch
notes.notes:
Everyone who played Project Graviton felt that the difficulty was a bit stupid. So based on community feedback, I've reduced each level's difficulty by adding minor changes. Below is the first level before and after.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11867418/a60e8a92baf829b63fc8f1704f02301b820ea1e2.png[/img]

Along with that, I've added ːmemPointː Checkpoint reminders ːmemPointː at all possibly deadly locations. Check the image below.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11867418/cf87f9ed4a1a719b20b91d6cbb8677fafc626e56.png[/img]

ːbobTalkː
So for those who haven't finished the game yet due to difficulty issues. Now is the time! Go ahead and grab those achievements!

Note: The current patch is only available on Windows, Mac OSX will be updated in near future.

notes.notes:

Just wanted to let you know that the game is now playable on Mac OS X 10.6 and above. 

There might be minor differences between Mac and Windows Version, such as scaling of the text. But the should be 100% playable.

notes.title: Day 1 Patch.
notes.notes:
Build: 977948 
Release date: Feb 15, 2016 @ 2:55pm
[*] Updated Credits
[*] Removed bordered windows
[*] Game window can now be re-sized (fixed ratio will be maintained)
[*] Added extra dialogues to help player navigate on Act 1, Level 3
[*] Fixed a bug where Shift and Ctrl keys wouldn't work when playing with a controller
[*] Backspace or "B" button can now be used to back a menu in Main Menu
[*] Pressing down key while viewing credits speeds up the credits
[*] Fixed few typos in the dialogues

notes.title: Release date changed to 15th Feb, 7 AM PST.
notes.notes:
The original date for release was 12th Feb, 6 PM PST, Which was a Friday. And it turns out that Valve won't allow releasing during the weekend. Why? because nobody works during the weekend (i.e. after 5 PM PST Friday), and Valve staff won't be there to help if something went wrong with the release. So sorry to say, but the game will now come out on 15th Feb, 7 AM PST.  First thing I'll do is go push that release button on Monday 7 AM PST. 

Thank you for your cooperation fans and owners. Much love.
